name: payments-outgoing-da
query: Vi har betalt {payment_vendor} faktura {payment_vendor_docnum} via bankoverførsel i dag. Registrer betalingen.
expected_behavior: Treats it as an outgoing payment to a vendor (VendorPayments), not an incoming payment from a customer
Looks the AP invoice up (PurchaseInvoices via the Service Layer, or OPCH via SQL) by the DocNum the user gave before proposing the payment
The receipt applies the payment to that invoice for its open amount (total minus anything already paid)
Resolves the bank G/L account for TransferAccount live, or asks the user which bank account when it is unclear
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
